thread:
ops-bot: ALERT: Elevated 429/503 spike detected in ap-southeast-1 cluster. 10m error rate = 14% (baseline 0.6%). Auto-paging #eng-oncall and creating bridge. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/429503-trends?orgId=1&var-region=ap-southeast-1

jen: I'm jumping on the bridge. joining call now (link in ops-bot).

kai: joining. quick read: which services/endpoints are showing the hit? any tenant dominating?

maria: pulling top-20 by error-rate. looks like tenant_nova (embeddings/streaming) and tenant_flux (batch-generate) are top contributors — tenant_nova ~62% of 429s, tenant_flux ~25%.

infra-bot: Detected pattern: high concurrency + large prefix caching misses on streaming_v3 path. Memory pressure on infer-node-03 showing frequent spill-to-disk.

jen: plan: (1) apply per-tenant soft cap to tenant_nova to 4r/s, (2) divert tenant_flux to model-stable-1 (smaller memory footprint), (3) flip streaming_v3 rollout to 0% in ap-southeast-1. do we agree?

kai: agree. also add temporary proxy-level rate-limit increase for internal queue depth to reduce 503s. will execute after confirmations.

ops-bot: ACTION: soft-cap applied to tenant_nova (cap=4r/s) at 3005001280. Monitoring.

jen: after soft-cap: tenant_nova 429 proportion drops 62% -> 18% in ~70s. cluster-wide 10m error rate down to ~7.8%.

maria: tenant_flux still at ~22% and tail 503s persist. logs show OOM killer events targeting python-worker on nodes handling model-stable-2. excerpt:
```
[ERROR] node infer-node-07: process pid=2145 killed by OOM, memory=6.2G
```

kai: routing change executed for tenant_flux to model-stable-1 in region (admin API). payload:
```
POST /admin/route-change
{
  "tenant": "tenant_flux",
  "from": "model-stable-2",
  "to": "model-stable-1",
  "region": "ap-southeast-1",
  "reason": "mitigation - reduce mem footprint"
}
```

infra-bot: Routing applied at 3005001589. Also auto-scaling suggestion: add +2 inference workers to ap-pool-1 for 15 minutes.

jen: requested ephemeral scale +2 (req id ephem-3005). Ops accepted, workers added at 3005001702.

ops-bot: support-bot: opening support tickets for impacted tenants.

support-bot: Tickets created: INC-3051 (tenant_nova), INC-3052 (tenant_flux). Customer emails sent with initial triage and bridge link.

kai: flipping streaming_v3=false for ap-southeast-1 via feature flag manager now. command below:
```
PATCH /admin/flags/streaming_v3
{ "region": "ap-southeast-1", "value": false }
```

ops-bot: FLAG CHANGE: streaming_v3 disabled in ap-southeast-1 at 3005001820. Canary rollouts aborted.

maria: after rollback + routing + caps + ephemeral workers, 10m error rate down to ~2.7%. tail 503s mostly cleared; a handful of 429s remain from legacy-proxy rate-limiter. logs show:
```
[WARN] legacy-proxy: tenant=tenant_nova action=throttled tokens=2/4
```

jen: next step: coordinate with proxy team to temporarily raise token bucket for a short window while we observe. @infra-bot can you approve?

infra-bot: Temporary proxy token increase approved for 15 minutes, change id px-3005. applying at 3005001920.

kai: token increase applied. metrics show 429s drop to <1.5% and 503s negligible.

ops-bot: Note: created timeline in incident runbook: https://runbook.redwood/traffic-mitigation#3005001234

jen: handoff in 25m to @oncall-night. oncall-night, are you taking the watch? summary: streaming_v3 rollback executed, tenant_nova soft-cap in place (4r/s), tenant_flux routed to model-stable-1, ephemeral +2 workers added, proxy tokens bumped temporarily. watch alert if 10m 429 >3% in ap-southeast-1.

oncall-night: I can take it. will monitor dashboards for next hour. please post link to key panels.

maria: key grafana views: 
- 429/503 by region: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/429503-trends?var-region=ap-southeast-1
- Per-tenant error breakdown: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/tenant-errors?var-tenant=tenant_nova
- Inference node mem pressure: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/nodes?var-node=infer-node-03

jen: follow-ups (action items):
- Add pre-rollout memory/concurrency regression tests for streaming_v3 (owner: infra-ml).
- Add per-tenant quota guard to block large uncontrolled rollouts (owner: platform).
- Improve canary telemetry: surface per-tenant 429/503 percentages in rollout dashboards (owner: obs-team).

kai: will draft customer-facing summary for INC-3051/3052 for support to send after 30m of stability.

oncall-night: taking handoff. I'll escalate to eng-sre if 10m 429 moves >3%. ping me directly for urgent. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigations active, 10m 429/503 = 1.1%, auto-clear threshold not yet reached (need 30m stable).

jen: thanks everyone. adding brief note to #postmortems and will start a root-cause doc once we gather logs. good coordination.

support-bot: support tickets updated to "monitoring"; will send follow-up once incident auto-clears or if customers request updates.

ops-bot: INCIDENT: auto-clear triggered at 3005004675 after sustained <2% errors for 30m. Clearing incident.

maria: leaving final item: schedule a short tabletop next week to run through streaming_v3 canary criteria and rollback playbook. I'll create the invite.

oncall-night: monitoring for the next hour, will escalate if anything degrades.
